enUS.Assets.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.IndustrialArea]: Draw an Industrial Area boundary. It becomes active once an office building inside it is assigned as the headquarters.
enUS.Assets.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.ParkArea]: Draw a Park Area boundary. It requires a Park Maintenance headquarters and a dedicated pedestrian path crossing the boundary.
enUS.Assets.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.TourismArea]: Tourism is currently a boundary only. No tourism gameplay (observations, scoring or progression) is implemented; it is planned for a future update.
enUS.Assets.SUB_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION[CS2AS Are: Choose the kind of management area to draw.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.InputStarvat: Producers that had workers but not enough input stock for one unit (continuity · facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.Insufficient: Output is blocked while cargo facilities in this area are not operating (continuity · idle cargo facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.LowActivePro: Producing facilities below 75% of all extractor/processing buildings (share · idle or vacant facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.LowEfficienc: Building efficiency below 70% (efficiency · facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.LowProfitabi: Companies losing money or worse (viability · companies' facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.StorageSatur: Producers whose storage was full (continuity · facilities · observed hours). The cause is not assumed.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Bottleneck.WorkforceSho: Job fill below 75% (fill · understaffed facilities · observed hours).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Calculating: Waiting for the first hourly observation…
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Check.LogisticsRoute: Developed logistics route (operating cargo facility or Logistics ≥ 70)
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Comparison.Tip: Managed Industrial Areas only. Current Performance sorts first; stale results are advisory and do not affect gameplay.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.DailyXp.Tip: At most 240 XP per game day.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Day.InsufficientCoverag: Not counted: fewer than 18 observed hours
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.FocusTarget.Tip: Moves the camera to a representative facility behind this diagnostic. Nothing in the city is changed.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.HourlyXp.Tip: Production 35%, Employment 25%, Logistics 20%, Performance 20% (three of four needed), divided by 10, at most 10 per game hour. No bonus for area size.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.LastDay.Tip: A day counts with at least 18 valid observed game hours and a time-weighted activity average of at least 80.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.LastUpdate.Tip: Start of the last completed hourly observation.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.ActiveShare.Tip: Extractor and processing buildings currently producing, out of all of them (vacant ones included).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Activity.Tip: Current production rate shown by the game for each company, divided by its rate at full staff and 100% efficiency. Job-weighted.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.BuildingEfficien: Vanilla efficiency (100% = normal; bonuses can exceed 100%).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Diversity.Tip: 1, 2 or 3+ outputs with at least 20% of the leading output's activity score 50, 75 or 100.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Efficiency.Tip: Vanilla building efficiency 70% and company profitability 30%.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Employment.Tip: Filled industrial jobs 75% and per-facility staffing balance 25%. Office-only jobs are excluded.
Share of observed time producers could still make at least one unit from their stock of inputs.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.JobFill.Tip: Employees / jobs of industrial companies and logistics facilities in this area.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Logistics.Tip: Input continuity 50% and output/dispatch continuity 50% over the last six game hours. Warehouses or terminals give no points by themselves.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.OutputContinuity: Share of observed time producers were not blocked by full storage.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Performance.Tip: Production 35%, Logistics 25%, Employment 20%, Efficiency 20%. One missing component is reweighted; with two missing it is unavailable.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Production.Tip: Productive activity 65%, active producers 25%, output diversity 10%. Requires a validated activity reading.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Metric.Profitability.Ti: Vanilla company profitability mapped from Bankrupt (0–20) to Profitable (80–100).
Average fill of the facilities that offer jobs.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.ExternalCargo: Cargo routes outside this area are not observed; a missing terminal here is not treated as a problem.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.HqHealth: The headquarters' vacancy or poor operating health never suspends the area and has no penalty in this version.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.NoBuff: Level does not directly increase production, cargo capacity, efficiency, profitability, taxes or demand.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.NoPlacementBonus: Placing warehouses or cargo terminals gives no points by itself; only observed flow counts.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.OfficesExcluded: Office-only workplaces are not counted as industrial jobs.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.Overlap: These buildings belong to an overlapping Industrial Area with a smaller ID, which counts them.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.Prestige: Industrial Powerhouse needs any two prestige objectives.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Note.Sampled: Production figures are sampled current rates of the real companies, not lifetime production counters.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.OverlapMembers: Overlapping buildings counted by another Industrial Area
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Process.Tip: A production process observed in this area: the input resources the game's recipe consumes and the resource it produces, with the current daily output of its companies (sampled).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.RawActivity.Tip: Unclamped value; only scoring is limited to 100%.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Resource.Tip: Current production rate per day shown by the game for companies here (sampled, not a lifetime counter).
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Status.Stale: Paused or delayed: last value, not current
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.InputStarvat: Bring suppliers of the missing inputs closer or improve freight access to this area.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.Insufficient: Restore the area's cargo stations (staff, utilities, budget) or connect it to another terminal.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.LowActivePro: Look at idle or vacant buildings: demand, workers and inputs decide whether companies move in and produce.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.LowEfficienc: Check the buildings' efficiency details: electricity, water, garbage, mail or staffing.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.LowProfitabi: Review input costs, taxes and demand for the products made here.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.StorageSatur: Check demand for the outputs and freight access for outgoing trucks, trains or ships.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Suggestion.WorkforceSho: Improve housing, education or transit access for workers.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Summary.Active: Active. Metrics come from the real companies inside this area, observed once per game hour.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Summary.HeadquartersInv: Suspended: the headquarters building was removed or is no longer inside this area. Assign a new headquarters; Level and XP are kept.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Summary.HeadquartersReq: Assign an office building inside this area as the headquarters to activate it.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.Delayed: The last observation took longer than one game hour; it counts for no XP or coverage.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.HeadquartersInv: The headquarters building is gone or outside the area: suspended.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.HeadquartersReq: No headquarters: the area is suspended and earns no XP.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.Observing: Observing real companies. Scores appear after the first hourly observation.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.Paused: Suspended: the values below are the last observation and are paused.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.Warning.ReadFailures: Some buildings could not be read and were skipped:
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.XpBlocked.AlreadySettle: This game hour was already settled.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.XpBlocked.InsufficientI: No XP: fewer than three of Production, Employment, Logistics and Performance are available.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.XpBlocked.NoOperatingPr: No XP: no facility is producing.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.XpBlocked.Stale: No XP: the observation was delayed or not current.
enUS.CS2AS.Industrial.XpBlocked.Suspended: No XP: the area is suspended.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Action.Accessibility: Add entrances, footpaths or a nearby transit stop
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Action.Attractiveness: Add attractions or improve the landscape
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Action.Comfort: Expand the Park or add paths and amenities
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Action.Satisfaction: Improve the visitor experience (and check the fee)
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Action.Variety: Add different kinds of facilities and landscaping
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Budget.Tip: 100% funds the estimated area management need. Lower budgets reduce Maintenance; higher budgets help with diminishing returns.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Capacity.Tip: Estimated from area, footpaths, facilities and amenities. Park level does not change it.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Connectivity.Disconnected: Facility not connected to the entrance pedestrian network
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Connectivity.Partial: Partial scan — connectivity not yet determined
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowAmenities: Few rest amenities such as benches or tables.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowAmenities.Tip: Rest & amenities score below half its weight.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowDecoration: Little decoration from the Park or stone prop menus.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowDecoration.Tip: Decoration scores below half its weight.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowLighting.Tip: Lighting scores below half its weight.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowPaths: Few footpaths for this Park's size.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowPaths.Tip: Footpaths score below half their weight.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowVegetation: Little vegetation for this Park's size.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.LowVegetation.Tip: Vegetation scores below half its weight. Trees and plants of different kinds help most.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.SparseAmenities: Rest amenities are concentrated in a small part of the Park.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.SparseAmenities.Ti: Fewer than a quarter of the Park's landscaped sections have amenities. The button shows a busy section without any. Advisory only: the score is unchanged.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.SparseLighting: Lighting is concentrated in a small part of the Park.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Diagnostic.SparseLighting.Tip: Fewer than a quarter of the Park's landscaped sections have lighting. The button shows a busy section without any. Advisory only: the score is unchanged.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Fee.Tip: Charged once per visit from the visitor's household money to the city. It does not change where citizens go.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.FocusTarget.Tip: Moves the camera to a representative object for this finding. Nothing in the city is changed.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Landscape.Tip: Vegetation, rest amenities, decoration, lighting and footpaths. Variety counts; repeating one object quickly stops helping.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.ManagementCost.Tip: Grounds and administration overhead of the Park Area, paid from city money.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Accessibility.Tip: Entrances (and how spread out they are), nearby public transport, footpaths inside the Park and footpaths reaching each entrance.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Attractiveness.Tip: About 60% real facility attractiveness and 40% landscape.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Comfort.Tip: Crowding relative to the estimated comfortable capacity. Popularity only hurts above that capacity.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Maintenance.Tip: Condition of the Park's vanilla park buildings plus area management funded by the Park budget.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Satisfaction.Tip: Rolling average of completed visits; starts near 50 until enough visits are observed.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Metric.Variety.Tip: Different kinds of leisure facilities and landscape categories. Breadth beats repetition.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Note.Prestige: Landmark Park needs any two of the three Landmark objectives.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Note.SatisfactionPrior: Few visits so far: satisfaction is still close to the neutral starting value.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Note.VanillaSeparate: Normal upkeep and income of the buildings inside are handled by the base game and are not included here.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Preview.Tip: Estimate using current Quality and recent visitor volume, assuming full fee collection. Demand, household affordability and routing are not predicted. Preview controls do not apply settings.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Quality.Tip: Satisfaction 25%, Attractiveness 20%, Accessibility 15%, Variety 15%, Maintenance 15%, Comfort 10%.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Recent.Tip: Last in-game day. Recent statistics restart after loading a save.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.RecentNet.Tip: Admission income minus area management cost.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.RecentUncollected.Tip: Fees visitors' households could not afford. Visitors still entered; a high value suggests the fee is too high for them.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.Active: Open. Visits are measured from real residents' and tourists' leisure trips.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.BothRequired: Suspended: assign a Park Maintenance headquarters and connect a dedicated pedestrian path across the boundary.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.EntranceInvalid: Suspended: none of the assigned entrances qualifies any more. Remove the marked entrances and assign a park, leisure or attraction building inside this area.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.EntrancePending: Headquarters ready; waiting for a dedicated-path entrance scan.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.EntranceRequired: Connect a dedicated pedestrian path from outside into the Park, or assign an explicitly registered entrance asset.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.HeadquartersInvalid: Suspended: the saved headquarters is invalid. Assign a Park Maintenance building; progress is preserved.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Summary.HeadquartersRequired: Suspended: assign a Park Maintenance building inside this area as headquarters.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.TourismContribution.Tip: Derived value for a future Tourism Area. It does not change vanilla tourism.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.Cluttered: Too many objects packed together: a clutter penalty applies.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.Crowded: Over comfortable capacity: visitors feel crowded.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.HeadquartersInvalid: Saved headquarters is invalid; assign Park Maintenance inside this area.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.HeadquartersRequired: Park Maintenance headquarters required; Level, XP and finance are kept.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.LowConfidence: Some quality data is not available yet; a neutral value is used.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.LowMaintenance: Poor maintenance: raise the Park budget or look after park buildings.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.NoEntrance: No valid entrance: the Park is suspended. Level, XP and statistics are kept.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.NoFacilities: No park, leisure or attraction buildings inside: nobody can visit yet.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.NotPrimary: Overlaps another Park: visitors at shared buildings are counted only by the other Park.
enUS.CS2AS.Park.Warning.PoorValue: The admission fee feels too high for this Park's quality.
enUS.CS2AS.Policy.Reason.EffectUnavailable: Effect not available in this game version
enUS.CS2AS.Policy.Reason.Suspended: Paused while the Area is suspended
enUS.CS2AS.Policy.Reason.Unknown: This policy's module is not installed. The saved setting is kept.
enUS.CS2AS.Policy.Reason.UnsupportedAreaType: Not available for this Area type
enUS.CS2AS.Summary.AnchorRequired: Assign a required facility to activate this area.
enUS.CS2AS.Summary.ModuleUnavailable: This area's module is unavailable. Saved state is retained.
enUS.CS2AS.Summary.Quarantined: This area's saved data is inconsistent or its native search geometry is unavailable, so it is isolated for this session. Saved data and geometry are kept unchanged; membership, activation, policies and finance are disabled. Only Edit and Delete are available. Edit the geometry or delete the unwanted area, then reload.
enUS.CS2AS.Summary.TourismBoundaryOnly: Boundary only. No tourism gameplay (observations, scoring or progression) is implemented; it is planned for a future update.
enUS.CS2AS.Trend.Tip: Change of the item above between its latest and previous hourly samples. Samples are kept for this session only and reset on load.
enUS.CS2AS.UI.SelectAnchor: Select an existing building inside this area.
enUS.CS2AS.UI.SelectEntrance: Click an explicitly registered entrance building inside this area.
enUS.CS2AS.UI.SelectHeadquarters: Click an office building inside this area to assign it as the headquarters.
enUS.Options.OPTION[CS2AreaSystem.CS2AreaSyst: Move camera to areas picked from the list
Expand managed area list by default
enUS.Options.OPTION_DESCRIPTION[CS2AreaSystem: When on, overlaps between management areas are warnings and can be completed. When off they remain native errors. Overlaps with vanilla areas, unpurchased tiles and invalid shapes remain blocking errors.
Asks for confirmation before deleting an area from the management panel.
When an area is picked in the managed area list, the camera moves to it.
Chooses the screen side for the managed area list and the anchor-assignment hint. Area details appear in the game's selected-info panel.
Restores every setting of this mod to its default value.
When on, the list starts expanded. When off, it starts collapsed, but the button for selecting completed areas remains visible. Use the button to open or close it at any time.
enUS.Options.WARNING[CS2AreaSystem.CS2AreaSys: Reset all settings to their defaults?
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Advanced: Raises facility productivity while reducing labour demand.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Enhanced: Park management is funded 25% above the budget setting: the management expense and the maintenance coverage both rise by 25%.
Favours stable, safe operation over extreme utilisation.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Environm: Reduces environmental burden with a modest production trade-off. Conflicts with Production Priority.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.FocusedM: Area XP from awards the Area already qualifies for is increased by 10%. It never bypasses earning requirements or daily XP caps.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Landscap: Vegetation and decoration count 25% more toward the Landscape score; 15% of the comfortable visitor capacity is closed to visitors.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Logistic: Favours real input and output flow and reduces logistics blockage.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.MajorEve: Attracts many more visitors with major events, with strong crowding and high upkeep.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.NightEve: Draws more visitors with evening events, with more crowding and noise. Conflicts with Quiet Operations.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.PremiumS: Visitors consider an admission fee up to 30% higher to be fair, which softens the value-for-money penalty of higher fees.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Producti: Raises production with a higher environmental burden. Conflicts with Stronger Environmental Regulation.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.QuietOpe: Lowers visitor pressure in favour of quiet, satisfying visits. Conflicts with Night Events.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.Restrict: Reduces night-time noise with lower total production. Conflicts with 24-Hour Operations.
enUS.Policy.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS.Policy.TwentyFo: Raises operating activity with more noise and operating cost. Conflicts with Restricted Operating Hours.
enUS.Services.DESCRIPTION[CS2AS Areas Menu]: Create Park, Industrial and Tourism management areas. Boundaries never clear existing buildings or roads.
